Used a None-sentinel resolved inside each function body instead (if alive is None: alive = process_alive) -- identical externally observable default behavior, now=None already used exactly this pattern per the handoff's own suggestion. Verified with a minimal reproduction (def f(x=g): ... NameError) before diagnosing. Added 9 new tests (EntryLivenessTests class): 5 direct entry_liveness bucket tests + the 4 required-evidence active_duplicate integration tests (cli dead-pid frees; cli live-pid blocks; external phantom >8h frees using the REAL epic-568-441 archived shape; external within-8h blocks).
